front.name: UDG Draft Archetypes
front.rulesText:
{W}{U} *Retreat Tempo* Reuse creatures and manipulate blockers.
{B}{R} *Reckless Aggro* Trade staying power for aggressive pressure.
{G}{W} *Escort Convoy* Assemble a convoy of powerful creatures.
{U}{R} *Climbing Tempo* Play evasive threats backed by disruption.
{R}{W} *Zeal Go-Wide* Cast creature spells and win by the numbers.
{U}{B} *Grind Control* Mill opponents and play the long game.
{R}{G} *Ravage Stompy* Attack big and punish blockers.
{W}{B} *Mourn Recursion* Trade creatures, gain life, and bring them back.
{B}{G} *Death Value* Turn creature deaths into lasting value.
{G}{U} *Lost Technology* Ramp into artifacts and expensive spells.

front.name: UDG New Keywords
front.rulesText:
*Barrier [cost]*: If a source would deal damage to this creature, prevent that damage unless that source's controller pays [cost]. 
*Bulwark*: Can block an additional creature.
*Climbing*: Can't be blocked by creatures with greater toughness.
*Deathlink*: Whenever it deals combat damage, target player loses that much life.
*Escort*: Whenever it attacks, target creature without escort can't be blocked this turn.
*Grind*: Whenever it deals combat damage, target player mills that many cards.
*Nullify*: Whenever it blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, that creature loses all abilities until end of combat.

back.name: UDG New Keywords (cont.)
back.rulesText:
*Mourn*: Whenever a creature card is put into your graveyard, you gain 1 life.
*Ravage*: It can deal excess combat damage to another creature defending player controls.
*Riposte*: Whenever it is dealt damage by another creature, it deals that much damage back.
*Retreat:* Whenever it becomes blocked, you may return it to its owner's hand.
*Rush [N]*: You may cast it for N less. At the beginning of your next upkeep, sacrifice it unless you pay N.
*Sleeper*: It can't attack unless it is modified.
*Zeal*: Whenever you cast a creature spell, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
